subject: SLA packaging & final pricing options for BluePeak
messages:
From: Emily Park <epark@bluepeak.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: SLA options for production rollout

Hey Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move our core inference workloads to Redwood but procurement needs clear SLA and pricing buckets before we can open an SOW. A few firm asks from legal/procurement: 
- We need an uptime target that supports our analytics pipelines (looking for 99.95% or better for production).
- 24/7 escalation for Sev 1 incidents with a guaranteed 30-minute acknowledgement window for critical incidents.
- Clarity on credits (how they are calculated) and an option for an on-call retainer.
- Pricing for three packaging options: baseline, priority, and enterprise (include monthly retainer if applicable).

Do you have a short summary and ballpark pricing? Procurement also asked for a template quote to run internally. Attaching our internal procurement form.

Appreciate a quick turn — aiming to review vendor terms by next week.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Platform Ops, BluePeak Analytics
Emily.Park@bluepeak.io

Attachment: BluePeak_Procurement_Form.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <epark@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@consultants.org>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA options for production rollout

Hi Emily — good to connect. Per your request, I put together three concise packages and an attached one-page SLA summary plus a detailed quote workbook. High level: 

1) Standard 
- Uptime: 99.9%
- Response: Business-hours support (M-F 7am-7pm PT), 4 hour initial response for Sev1
- Credits: Pro-rata token-based credit up to 5% of monthly fees
- Pricing: $4,500/mo retainer optional (recommended for burst/preemptive support)

2) Priority
- Uptime: 99.95%
- Response: 24/7 escalation with 1 hour acknowledgement for Sev1, dedicated escalation queue
- Credits: Sliding scale, up to 10% of monthly fees; automatic incident RCA within 48 hours
- Pricing: $12,000/mo retainer (includes prioritized capacity reservations)

3) Enterprise+ (for mission-critical workloads)
- Uptime: 99.99% SLA target with regional redundancy options
- Response: 24/7 dedicated on-call primary contact, 30 minute acknowledgement for Sev1 and on-site engineering hop if requested via retainer
- Credits: Higher-tier credit formula and automatic rollback to last-known-good model snapshot on major regressions
- Pricing: custom — typically $28K+/mo retainer + committed monthly usage offset

Notes: 
- We calculate credits as a percentage of the affected service's monthly invoice, pro-rated by duration and severity.
- For BluePeak specifically, I included two pricing rows in the attached workbook: a 12-month commit and a 24-month commit with stepped discounts.

Attachments: SLA_Summary_BluePeak_2027-01.pdf, Quote_BluePeak_v3.xlsx

If it helps I can propose a middle-ground: Priority package with a custom 30-minute critical ack add-on (price to be determined) — let me know if that’s required. I copied Oliver in case you want a quick procurement alignment call.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: BluePeak pricing ask — approval needed for discount and retainer flexibility

Marcus/Laura — looping you in. BluePeak is asking for 99.95% + 30 minute ack for critical incidents and wants a three-tier quote. I proposed Standard/Priority/Enterprise+ and attached the quote workbook. Highlights:
- Their procurement team will push for a 20% discount if we want to win the whole platform migration.
- They care about clear credit calculations and a 24/7 on-call path.

Can we approve up to 20% discount on the Priority line if they commit 24 months and sign an advanced payment for 3 months upfront? Alternatively, we could offer 15% + $8K retainer reduction for the first quarter. Need guidance on on-call staffing expectations if we promise 30-minute ack SLA.

Also: deal_id BP-4832. I want to keep CSM involvement mandatory for any >15% discount. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: BluePeak pricing ask — approval needed for discount and retainer flexibility

+1 on requiring CSM involvement for any discount >15%. Financials: 20% is steep given the retainer model unless we get 24-month heavy commit and partial upfront. Recommend we: 
- Offer 17.5% off list on Priority with a 24-month commit or 15% with 12-month + 3-month upfront.
- Keep Enterprise+ custom and protected — escalate to Solutions for any on-site/engineer hop commitments.
- If we accept 30-min ack, that must be gated by an additional on-call retainer to cover out-of-hours engineering (we should price this as an add-on, $6K/mo minimum).

I approve proceeding with the proposed counter. Marcus

Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Emily Park <epark@bluepeak.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.io>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@consultants.org>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA options for production rollout

Soojin — thanks for the detail. Procurement reviewed and here’s where we land: 
- We are willing to sign a 24-month commitment if Redwood can get to a 20% discount on the Priority package and include the 30-minute ack for critical incidents as part of the package (no add-on).
- We’ll do 3 months upfront payment if terms are favorable.
- We also want the credit calculation explicitly stated in the contract and an automatic incident severity review within 24 hours.

I attached our procurement form with required fields. If you can’t do 20% but can do 17.5% and include the 30-minute ack as a paid retainer that’s clearly documented, we can accept that as a fallback.

Emily

Attachment: BluePeak_Procurement_Form.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <epark@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA options for production rollout — final counter

Emily — appreciate the clarity and the willingness to commit. Final counter from Redwood: 
- Pricing: Priority package at 17.5% off list for a 24-month commitment with 3 months advanced payment. We can stretch to 17.5% (middle ground between our teams).
- 30-minute acknowledgement for critical incidents: included as a covered upgrade for the first 12 months; after that it will roll into the standard retainer/add-on unless you maintain the 24-month commit. We will provide a named escalation contact and access to the Priority queue 24/7.
- Credits: We will adopt a fixed credit table in contract: 99.95–99.9 = 5% credit, 99.9–99.0 = 10% credit, <99.0 = 25% credit, with pro-rata reductions by impacted region. Will include auto RCA within 24 hours for Sev1.
- Retainer: We will include a $6,000/mo on-call retainer discounted to $4,000/mo for the first quarter (to cover 30-min ack staffing), then $6,000/mo thereafter unless you keep a rolling 24-month commitment.

Next steps: I’ve attached the updated quote workbook and the one-page SLA summary. If you’re aligned, I’ll send a DocuSign packet containing the SOW and SLA appendix. We can also set a short legal call with Marcus and Laura to walk the credit language if needed.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/packet/BP-4832
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4832

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
